name: SaladCloud
summary: Distributed residential RTX 3090/4090 container cloud offering rock-bottom batch GPU pricing (~$0.08-$0.18/hr) for Dockerized LLM & SDXL workers.
ranking_rationale: Unbeatable per-hour RTX 3090/4090 container pricing for batch captioning, SDXL & Ollama workers (trade-off: nodes are residential gaming PCs—instances can preempt if a gamer starts playing).

pricing.notes: Pricing and promos change frequently; verify directly at official checkout.

pros: Unbeatable per-hour RTX 3090/4090 container pricing for batch captioning, SDXL & Ollama workers
Simple Docker container deployment with no long-term lock-in
Great for bulk dataset tagging or API workers
cons: Nodes are residential gaming PCs—instances can preempt if a gamer starts playing
Unsuited to stateful interactive desktops without external storage
